propositions: Read-only derivations over durable ticket event store must include compaction-retired events and support metrics: attempts-per-ticket, first-pass verification rate, rework at 7/30 days, reopen-recovery, and revert-linked recovery.

Attempts-per-ticket and rework-within-days metrics require raw event file reads with chronological sorting via event_sort_key and active event filtering, since compiled state retains only terminal values.
First-pass-rate and revert-recovery metrics use compiled state from reduce_ticket where terminal signal (last_reopened_at absence, reverts[] list) is sufficient.
Revert-recovery must filter target_event_type to STATUS or COMMITS (substantive reverts), excluding COMMENT and LINK reverts.
Empty date ranges return None (Unavailable); populated ranges with zero qualifying events return 0 (measured zero).
Metrics register with source=structural and confidence=high; escalation and handoff metrics are out of scope and report Unavailable.
